title: On My Way · Part 1
idea: At 11:52 pm your mom texts 'on my way, 10 min', but she's been home since ten, sitting on your couch, smiling at a TV that is off; the mom in the car can't find the house, a fox with a lantern stares at your front door, the couch creaks and a whisper asks who you're texting, and headlights turn into your street. TEXT or COUCH?
hook: It's 11:52 pm. Your mom just texted: on my way, ten minutes. Except she's sitting on your couch.
caption:
It's 11:52 pm. Mom texts: "On my way. 10 min." 📱
But she's been sitting on your couch since ten. Smiling at a TV that's off. 🛋️

YOUR CALL: one of them is your real mom.

Comment TEXT or COUCH. Part 2 follows the most-commented answer. 🦊🏮
